name: onda
description: Connect the Onda MCP server: read your Projects, followed accounts and Hits (publications with far more views than their author has followers) on Instagram, YouTube and TikTok. On your explicit request, run a new collection or get an Instagram transcript with your Onda plan. Needs one native step, hermes mcp add onda --url https://api.getonda.ru/mcp --auth oauth, then a browser sign-in to Onda; no API key. A paid Onda plan is required.
